text: 2026年8月19日上午9:50—10:20，中央国库现金管理操作室进行了2026年第14期中央国库现金管理商业银行定期存款招标。本期招标计划存款量700亿元，存款期限1个月（28天），采取单一价格招标，实际中标总量700亿元，中标利率1.62%。国库于当日将款项存入中标银行，同时质押足额债券。(中国人民银行)
text_en: On the morning of August 19, 2026, from 9:50 to 10:20, the Central Treasury Cash Management Office conducted the bidding for the 14th batch of 2026 central treasury cash management commercial bank time deposits. The planned deposit volume for this batch was 70 billion yuan, with a term of one month (28 days), using single-price bidding. The actual winning volume was 70 billion yuan, with a winning rate of 1.62%. The Treasury deposited funds into winning banks that day, while pledging sufficient bonds as collateral. (PBOC)
